# UI Platform — Model Briefing

UI is an open-source workspace and developer productivity platform designed as an all-in-one replacement for Jira, Slack, Linear, and Notion. It features highly responsive keyboard-driven navigation, a centralized team planner, and built-in virtual office audio/video conferencing spaces.

## Key Capabilities
- **Unified Workspace:** Fuses project tracking, sprint schedules, documentation wiki, and chat logs into a single interface.
- **High-Performance Rendering:** Achieves up to 120 FPS render rate for responsive interactions, utilizing vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with GSAP 3.
- **Embedded virtual office:** Integrates instant conferencing rooms directly inside files and tasks.

## Visual Archetype
- **Color Scheme:** Deep space charcoal (#090a0c), electric azure (#3d7eff), and violet highlights.
- **Interactions:** Custom rotating border-beam active halos, cursor-reactive glass bento grids, and dynamic dashboard clip-path flashlight reveals.
